Job description:
An invitation for cooperation is extended to qualified specialists for collaboration in the development and implementation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions and products based on Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Eligibility requirements include holding a university degree in Artificial Intelligence at the Master's or Ph.D. level, preferably graduates from reputable universities, especially those in Tehran such as Tehran University, Sharif University of Technology, Amirkabir University, University of Science and Industry, Shahid Beheshti University, Tarbiat Modares, and Science and Research University.

Proficiency in concepts and technologies related to Large Language Models (LLM), practical experience in designing and implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, experience in designing and developing AI Agents and Agentic AI, specialized knowledge and practical experience in Model Context Protocol (MCP) and designing and implementing MCP Server/MCP Client, mastery of Prompt Engineering and methods for optimizing interaction with language models, familiarity with Tool Calling/Function Calling, connecting language models to various services and systems, familiarity with Embedding, Vector Database, and Semantic Search, proficient knowledge of the Python programming language, and the ability to develop AI-related services, familiarity with designing and developing APIs and Backend services, the ability to study and analyze technical documentation and specialized articles, and applying new technologies in the field of AI.

Having a work history in AI projects, especially in the fields of LLM, RAG, AI Agent, and MCP, will be considered a special advantage. Submitting samples of work, implemented projects, research activities, GitHub projects, or experience in developing and deploying LLM-based systems will be considered in the evaluation process.

Expected competencies include the ability to transform AI concepts and technologies into practical and usable solutions in real-world environments, the ability to analyze problems and select appropriate architecture and technology for LLM-based solutions, interest and the ability for continuous learning in the field of modern AI technologies, teamwork skills and participation in the design and development of software products, and the ability to document technical aspects and provide proposed solutions.

The most important criteria for this job position will be specialized education in Artificial Intelligence, along with practical experience in the fields of LLM, RAG, Agent, and MCP. Individuals with a track record of professional activity in designing and implementing LLM and Agentic AI systems will be prioritized in the recruitment process.

Company description:
Karno company operates in the field of software development and providing digital solutions. We engage in the design and production of web-based enterprise software, relying on a specialized team of programmers, designers, and information technology experts. Our goal at Karno is to provide creative, efficient, and customer-needs-appropriate software products. We have created a dynamic, professional, and friendly environment so that team members can expand their skills and move towards professional and personal growth. If you are interested in the world of technology, learning, and collaboration in innovative projects, Karno can be a suitable place for you.
